description.value: Asian Avenue is Vernon's long-standing Chinese restaurant situated on Highway 97, a key cycling corridor through BC's interior. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, with a private banquet hall seating up to 100 guests equipped with audio/visual equipment. Its highway-side location makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through Vernon.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at asianavenue.ca is fully functional and confirms the business is a Chinese/Asian restaurant at 4101 - 32 Street (Hwy. 97), Vernon BC, with phone 250-549-4858. The site explicitly lists 'Take Out' as a service and the menu page notes gluten-friendly options. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only. OSM address and phone fields are blank so cross-check was not possible.
Website copyright reads © 2016 suggesting it may not have been updated recently, though business content appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant on Highway 97 in Vernon with an active website confirming address, phone, and services. A useful stop for touring cyclists on a major BC cycling route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'The Following Menu Is Gluten Friendly and Possibly Gluten Free' with a note to call to confirm for severe sensitivity or celiac conditions
